node.statement: If a finite-dimensional unital C*-algebra is noncommutative, its standard finite-dimensional decomposition as a direct sum of full matrix algebras has a summand M_d with d>=2. In a 2-by-2 corner of that summand take u=[[0,1],[1,0]] and v=[[1,0],[0,-1]], extending each by zero on the orthogonal corner and all other summands. Then ||u||=||v||=1 and [u,v]=[[0,-2],[2,0]] on that corner, so ||[u,v]||=2.
